summary: Preflight tool-call schema validation + sync proxy causing 200-600ms extra per request; customer experiencing streaming timeouts
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports a regression in end-to-end request latency after they enabled function/tool calling in their integration. The extra latency appears to be coming from preflight schema validation and a synchronous call to our toolcall proxy that adds noticeable round trips before token generation begins.

Impact:
- Acme Analytics (dedicated) is seeing p95 latency jump from ~220ms to ~780ms for simple text-generation requests that trigger tool calls.
- Multiple streaming connections aborted with client-side timeouts (observed 8-12 timeouts/hour over last 24h).
- Customer reports production traffic (ML feature store inference layer) degraded, user-facing timeouts.

Environment:
- prod, us-east cluster serving dedicated pool for Acme Analytics
- API path: /v1/chat/completions (tool calling enabled)
- Models affected: redwood-open-7b-v2 (default), fallback to oasst-6b also shows regression

Steps to reproduce (customer provided):
1) POST /v1/chat/completions with tool_call payload including tool name and JSON schema for tool args
2) Observe server response time and streaming behavior
3) Repeat with identical prompt but without tool_call; compare latencies

Observed behavior:
- Requests with tool_call: initial server processing time 200-600ms before any model tokens stream back.
- Requests without tool_call: no preflight delay; generation begins ~180-250ms.
- Server logs show synchronous POST to toolcall-proxy endpoint (10.0.5.23) per request for schema validation/normalization even when tool is not invoked (preflight).

Expected behavior:
- Preflight validation should be lightweight and fast (<30ms) or deferred/async; should not require blocking network round-trips that impact token emission.

Customer impact notes:
- Customer has configured client-side timeout of 1s for streaming handshake; with extra preflight delay many sessions hit timeout.
- This is a P1 for Acme Analytics, affecting user-facing features.

investigation_notes:
Findings:
- The serving runtime performs a blocking call to the toolcall-proxy for schema normalization on every request that includes a tool_call block.
- A recent change (deploy 2026-03-06) added a schema-resolver service which introduced a synchronous network hop with ~300-450ms median latency in us-east due to cold cache and a debounce timer.
- Calls were not properly cached per-tenant, causing repeated round trips for identical schemas.
- Streaming handshake waits for preflight to complete, so no tokens are emitted until proxy returns.
Evidence:
- tcpdump and request traces show a full TCP + HTTP exchange to 10.0.5.23 before model token emission.
- Canary tests that bypass preflight begin streaming immediately.
resolution:
Hotfix delivered 2026-03-12: implemented local LRU cache for schema-resolver and made preflight proxy calls async where possible; streaming path now begins token emission while background validation completes. Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 hours in prod-us-east. Post-deploy metrics show p95 latency for tool_call requests down to ~260ms and streaming timeouts dropped to near zero for the customer.
Follow-ups:
- Engineering to ship permanent fix in serving-runtime (PR created) that avoids blocking preflight entirely and adds tenant-level schema cache with eviction policy.
- Add regression test to infra-e2e for tool-call latency.
- Customer success to schedule a 1:1 and confirm full recovery; offer credit per SLA if still impacted.
